messages:
Tess (Partnerships): Quick sync request 1: where are we on marketplace readiness for H100 / H200 & B200 / MI300 / Gaudi? Specifically: marketplace image cert, SI dry-run readiness, and any legal embargo constraints. We need a recommended announce cadence to avoid vendor press collisions.
Maya (Eng-Platform): H100 image builds are green on inference tests but our container size hit the registry soft limit (4.7GB). Working on multistage slimming; estimate ~48h to drop ~600MB. Pull test command: `docker pull ghcr.io/redwood/h100:staging-20250501`
Maya (Eng-Platform): H200/B200: kernel + nvdriver combo OK, but our batcher shows 5-10% perf delta vs internal baseline when int8 quantization is applied. We'll capture perf profiles.
Jonah (Product): High-level propose cadence: H200/B200 announce week-of 1727000000, then MI300 week-of 1727600000, H100 follow week-of 1728200000. Gaudi can be earlier if SI dry-run completes. Also vendor press: NV has a big event on 1727050000 so avoid overlap.
Rachelle (Field/Sales): Field needs two weeks pre-announce enablement materials (one-pager + deck) and a short migration note for Dedicated customers for any mandatory firmware updates. Also need SKU mapping table for Hosted vs Dedicated.
Samir (SI Liaison): SI asks: can perf team run a 0.5M-token throughput run on MI300 with both fp16 and int8 exported weights? We need latency p95 and memory footprint. Also request a service account for marketplace testing: `svc-marketplace-int` (read-only to registry + image pull).
partner-bot: Heads-up: Legal policy requires 72h written notice to vendors for embargo changes and a signed embargo addendum for joint press. Link: https://docs.redwood/legal/vendor-embargo-guidelines
Maya (Eng-Platform): Gaudi status: lab image validated with kernel patches and Triton plugin 1.2. Found a manifest issue: marketplace manifest is missing `device_class: gaudi` which prevents auto-routing to Gaudi pools. I'll open PR to add manifest fields.
Jonah (Product): Quick gating matrix draft (one line each):
```
H100: driver >=2.1.x, fw signed by vendor, image <4.5GB preferred, manifest SKU: redwood:h100-ga, embargo preference: 1-week preannounce
H200/B200: driver stable 2.0.x, quantization supported (int8 recommended), manifest SKU: redwood:h200-b200-preview, embargo: coordinate with NV event
MI300: ROCm >=6.x, firmware pending vendor signoff, marketplace image tag: redwood:mi300-beta, require perf profile for int8/fp16
Gaudi: validated lab image ghcr.io/redwood/gaudi:staging-20250501, triton plugin 1.2, manifest fix required, embargo: flexible
```
Rachelle (Field/Sales): Please add columns for `docs_ready` and `sales_deck` to that matrix. When PRs land, drop links here so I can start creating enablement content.
Samir (SI Liaison): I'll schedule the SI dry-run for Gaudi and MI300 on 1725600000 (tentative) and will need VPC test creds + `svc-marketplace-int`. I'll post a runbook PR with checklist items by EOD today.
Maya (Eng-Platform): CI note: one flaky test on H100 related to mmap/hugepages. Short workaround: toggle `vm.nr_hugepages` in staging nodes. Will document steps in PR.
Tess (Partnerships): Thanks. Action items: 1) Maya 1 shrink H100 image + post PR with logs (48h). 2) Samir 1 PR runbook + confirm SI dry-run schedule (target 1725600000). 3) Jonah 1 finalize announce cadence and vendor comms (avoid 1727050000 NV event). 4) Rachelle 1 prepare sales stub and FAQ once manifests/PRs land. We'll confirm final embargo windows after the runbook and perf profiles are in. :white_check_mark:
